final.role: Generate several queries, fuse keyword and vector rankings
final.evidence: 複数の検索クエリを生成し、キーワード検索とベクトル検索の結果を再ランク付けして統合する手法です。

auditoria.nota: An LLM writes query variants and the result lists are merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Useful as a recall booster, at the cost of an LLM call per search.
